answer: Sybil resistance leverages microeconomic capital allocation, where non-refundable attestation fees and compounding opportunity costs build an escalating marginal cost curve for adversaries. Integrating staking collateral and zero-knowledge verifiable delay, protocols ensure any illicit computational voyage yields negative expected attack utility via strict slashing penalty. This cryptoeconomic primitive enforces a robust Nash equilibrium, ensuring each fraudulent sybil seeks a consensus pearl rather than exploiting a velvet monopoly over network state.
